Multisectoral humanitarian response in Somalia
"Norwegian Church Aid Somalia’s programme addresses urgent WASH, food security, and climate resilience needs through a community-led, rights-based approach. It improves access to safe water, sanitation, and hygiene, supports vulnerable households with food and livelihood assistance, and strengthens disaster preparedness.  The programme will be implemented together with the following national partners: KAALO Aid Development, Centre for Research and Integrated Development (CERID), Social-life and Agricultural Development Organization (SADO), Bani'Adam Relief and Development Organization (BANIADAM) "

flows.description: Somalia - NRC Strategic Partnership Agreement 	Flyktninghjelpen/NRC in Somalia provides a multi-sectoral lifesaving response with integrated services to address critical humanitarian needs, while contributing to increased self-reliance, resilience, and durable solutions for crisis-affected communities. The overall aim is to meet the essential needs of crisis-affected communities across Somalia. To ensure that the affected populations are at the centre of the response, NRC will actively collaborate with the local authorities and affected communities and will continue to take a lead role in strengthening humanitarian coordination in Somalia to avoid duplication of efforts. Sectors include Education, Information, counselling and legal assistance (ICLA), Livelihoods and food security (LFS), Protection from violence (PfV), Shelter and settlements, Water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH).
